translations.web: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.
translations.bsb: He is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering.
translations.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
translations.asv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin-offering, and kill the sin-offering in the place of burnt-offering.
